summary: Built a small Node.js sample demonstrating a LangChain-style orchestration (policy -> refund -> comms) that fetches an order from Azure DocumentDB (MongoDB-compatible), runs the three agents (LLM or deterministic mock) in sequence, and writes the final return document to the `returns` collection via Mongoose. The sample reads the DocumentDB connection string from DOCUMENTDB_URI and uses a mock LLM mode by default (no OPENAI_API_KEY) so demos and tests run without external LLM calls. I created seed and demo scripts and verified the end-to-end flow against the live cluster referenced by DOCUMENTDB_URI (seeded orders and persisted return documents).
how_to_run: 1. Copy .env.example to .env and set DOCUMENTDB_URI to your cluster connection string. Optionally set OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL to enable live LLM calls. 2. npm install 3. npm run seed    # idempotent - upserts two sample orders into sample_retail_18.orders 4. npm run demo    # runs two scenarios (ORD-001 approved path, ORD-002 rejected path) and prints the persisted return documents. 5. (Optional) node scripts/list-indexes.js to list indexes on orders and returns collections. The app exposes an Express POST /returns endpoint in src/server.js if you want to run as a service (node src/server.js).
verification_done: scripts/seed.js: ran and upserted ORD-001 and ORD-002 into sample_retail_18.orders
scripts/demo.js: ran; processed ORD-001 (approved) and ORD-002 (rejected) and wrote documents to sample_retail_18.returns; printed persisted documents
scripts/list-indexes.js: ran and printed indexes for orders and returns (orders.orderId unique index present; returns.orderId index present)
not_verified: documentdb MCP server calls (documentdb_list_indexes) failed when attempted; therefore MCP-based verification via the documentdb MCP tool was not completed. The app-level (Mongoose) verification of indexes/documents succeeded, so the feature was validated even though the MCP tool call failed (tool error).

Live LLM calls: not executed in the automated demo because OPENAI_API_KEY was not provided; the sample supports live calls if the user sets OPENAI_API_KEY and OPENAI_MODEL, but those runs were not performed here to avoid external LLM usage/cost.
open_issues: LangChain package import/export: during verification the installed 'langchain' package caused an ESM export error when attempting to import ChatOpenAI subpath. To keep the sample runnable in this environment I replaced direct langchain imports with direct OpenAI client calls for live LLM paths while keeping the orchestration semantics intact. If you prefer to use LangChain-specific classes (ChatOpenAI, Chains, Agents), you may need to switch the repo to ESM or align the langchain package version / import paths; I logged this decision and the error as evidence.

documentdb MCP tool use: the documentdb MCP 'list_indexes' call failed when tried from the build runner. I validated indexes/documents via Mongoose directly; if MCP verification is required, investigate connection_profile or MCP access in your environment.
